title: Jubilant Roasted German Pork Roast
description: A traditional German dish featuring a roasted pork roast with a sweet and sticky glaze, cooked to perfection in a cataplana vessel. This shojin-friendly recipe is perfect for a festive dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together the dark brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, water, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper.
Place the pork roast in a cataplana vessel and brush the sugar mixture evenly over the roast.
Add the chopped onion to the vessel and cover with a lid.
Roast the pork for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the pork rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Strain the juices from the vessel and serve alongside the pork.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
